hebrewText: צִדְקַ֣ת תָּ֭מִים תְּיַשֵּׁ֣ר דַּרְכּ֑/וֹ וּ֝/בְ/רִשְׁעָת֗/וֹ יִפֹּ֥ל רָשָֽׁע

tokens.bdb: rightness (abstractly), subjectively (rectitude), objectively (justice), morally (virtue) or figuratively (prosperity)
entire (literally, figuratively or morally); also (as noun) integrity, truth
tokens.kjv: without blemish, complete, full, perfect, sincerely (-ity), sound, without spot, undefiled, upright(-ly), whole.

tokens.bdb: to be straight or even; figuratively, to be (causatively, to make) right, pleasant, prosperous
tokens.kjv: direct, fit, seem good (meet), [phrase] please (will), be (esteem, go) right (on), bring (look, make, take the) straight (way), be upright(-ly).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to be straight or even; figuratively
tokens.enLiteralWord: to be straight or even; figuratively
tokens.explanation: to be straight or even; figuratively
tokens.explanationEn: to be straight or even; figuratively

tokens.bdb: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
tokens.kjv: along, away, because of, [phrase] by, conversation, custom, (east-) ward, journey, manner, passenger, through, toward, (high-) (path-) way(-side), whither(-soever).
tokens.explanation: derek — caminho, estrada, modo de vida, conduta

tokens.bdb: to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)
tokens.kjv: be accepted, cast (down, self, (lots), out), cease, die, divide (by lot), (let) fail, (cause to, let, make, ready to) fall (away, down, -en, -ing), fell(-ing), fugitive, have (inheritance), inferior, be judged (by mistake for H6419 (פָּלַל)), lay (along), (cause to) lie down, light (down), be ([idiom] hast) lost, lying, overthrow, overwhelm, perish, present(-ed, -ing), (make to) rot, slay, smite out, [idiom] surely, throw down.

tokens.bdb: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person
tokens.kjv: [phrase] condemned, guilty, ungodly, wicked (man), that did wrong.
